classification.difficultyReason: Identify taxable items from the receipt key, apply the supplied divide-by-11 calculation to those prices, and combine their GST without intermediate rounding.

inlines.text: Not all items in a supermarket attract GST.
Read the receipt carefully and answer the questions.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Highlight the prices that include GST.

answer.worked: Highlight \$4.95 (cream biscuits), \$1.92 (orange soft drink), \$2.45 (potato chips) and \$3.98 (hummus). Each item has an asterisk, which identifies a taxable item.

inlines.text: Complete the calculation to find the GST included in the price of biscuits. Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
The taxable price represents 110% of the pre-GST price. Dividing by 11 gives the GST, which is 10%.
$$\begin{align*}\text{GST (biscuits)}&=\frac{4.95}{11}\\&=0.45\end{align*}$$
The GST included is \$0.45.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Therefore, calculate the total GST included. Do not round intermediate results; give your final answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
Find the GST included in the orange soft drink, potato chips and hummus, then add the GST from the biscuits. Each taxable GST-inclusive price is divided by 11.
$$\begin{align*}\text{GST (soft drink)}&=\frac{1.92}{11}\\\text{GST (chips)}&=\frac{2.45}{11}\\\text{GST (hummus)}&=\frac{3.98}{11}\\\text{Total GST}&=\frac{4.95+1.92+2.45+3.98}{11}\\&=\frac{13.30}{11}\\&\approx1.21\end{align*}$$
The total GST included is \$1.21.
